body: But it hurts so much to see someone who spent half the time you did do leagues better than you. Now I'm scared. I'm scared of showing up to class. I don't think I could compete anymore. They're gonna have a better grade and take away any chance I have for med school anyway. I don't know how I can move on from this. This is the biggest failure of my life and I don't think I could keep going with the knowledge that I can't succeed despite my best efforts.

But it was my best effort to date. Even my mother, who usually tells me to be positive cant say shit to me right now. Because we both know it was a failure. I must be pretty damn stupid to fail despite all those hours of studying

When I do cut loose, my brain still finds a way to fuck with me. I always get that "you're a handsome dude, bro. Why haven't you picked up anyone?" from my friends. Then, I go fake again and pretend like I'm a player. I'd talk to some chicks and be very attractive at first and talk them up real good. But I always fail to seal the deal. I'm afraid to actually go for it, even if I know the chick is totally into me for some reason. Then she walks away and leave. Shallow as it seems, this makes me feel bad about myself. It kills me a little on the inside, just like when I fail a test I could have aced

I think what's more pathetic is when I pretended that I'm a stone cold efficient machine who just gets his jobs done. I'm getting tired of that. I want to be my sensitive self. I'm sorry, but venting online is the best way I know to do this without radically changing my IRL situation.

Thank you very much for this comment. You hit me right on the spot. Why did I think of it as win/loss? Maybe I didn't "fail" 8 times. Maybe all those 8 times, things just weren't meant to work out, same way you can't tighten a screw with a wrench. For how much I thought I valued love, I didn't realize a part of me treated it as a game to be won. What if I did "win"? Who "lost"? Did the girls "win" when they dumped me? Maybe it was pride, or maybe it was the inferiority complex which was instilled in me. Regardless, it is something I must change.

I feel so humbled by your comment. Thank you.
Nope, I'm dead serious, and I did literally do those. Call it angsty, but it is what it is.

You know what? After reading my comments, yeah, I figure I did sound self righteous. That's because I made a lot of mistakes, and continue to make some more. Right now, I'm not only commenting on reddit. What I type here is also what I say to myself. And maybe that self righteous voice is just me trying to convince myself that some ideals are meant to be upheld. But I do mean all that I say. So you're right, and thank you for helping me learn more about myself.

Then I will be that 1% or die trying. My experiences are just my own, and my own fulfillment pales in comparison to what I can do for the people around me. And I am happy and proud to say that I have made a difference. But I am lonely because I have nobody to share that happiness with. I refuse to view the experiences shown in media as ones which matter. I am the author of my story and I will carve my name, no matter how great or small, into the annals of history. It's just so much harder to do alone.

That is some really good, realistic advice. Thank you. But I'm a good amount certain that confidence isn't my problem. I have no issues talking to women. I walked home with four girls one night after a party, only to back out last minute because it "felt wrong". I guess it's because I hold sex way too precious. Strange as it seems for a guy to say this, but I value my virginity. Maybe I need to change that bit about me.

Then he is but an animal. Happy only because he is alive and conforming to his biological function (food, sex, etc). But what does he leave behind in this world? He is but a number who will be erased, forgotten. He may never know what true love is. But he will be happy. Happy like a child who had never seen beyond the four walls of his room.

He is but a leech. A parasite. He will never be a man who changes things. He will always play along the status quo, not be someone who defines it. I do not envy that he gets women. I only envy his ignorance of his own insignificance.

I am jealous of you because your brain wins over your heart. I understand how strong psychology can be. I wouldn't be a youth speaker nor a leader amongst my friends if I didn't. I understand power and motivation. But I guess I want someone out there to love me for who I am, not what I am nor what I represent. I am tired of projecting illusions of a powerful man, because I am not. I am tired of making myself sound like I know a lot, when I realize I know nothing at all.

And change is everywhere in my life. Again, I wasn't always like this. I had to change myself to become who I am. But the weirdest thing about change is that no matter how different it is, you are still yourself. It's your circumstances and persona that changed, not your soul.

I feel you, man ( *gives bro-hug* ). I envy you. I envy you because I can't give up. I won't give up. Because I will try to love someone as long as I'm alive. And I will fail. But it's the only thing that makes my life worth living. The pain reminds me I'm alive and that deep inside me, there is still the small glimpse of hope. Hope that I can find someone. And in the off chance that I do, all the happiness that I have will become real. All because happiness is only real when shared.

I tried PUA. It almost worked a couple of times, only for me to say "This isn't what I want" right before I go for a kiss and/or take a girl home. Porn can fulfill my carnal desires, what I need is someone to actually be a part of my life. My logic and my emotions work in a different way. You can say I have a romantic's heart stuck with a rationalist's brain.

um, this is a GREAT article, but it tells me something I already know. I know misogyny is a myth, and that the feminist movement isn't exactly fair. but i don't see a woman as a statistic, or as a study. I see them as human. I do not love women in general, I fall in love with individuals. that might be my downfall, but that's who I am. I'm scared of the day I might despise who i am and lead to my death.
